learner_operation: Identify the unchanged exponential, differentiate the polynomial exponent, retain the constant multiplier and natural-log factor; select or enter the resulting expression. Moderate evaluates it at a point; hard constructs a tangent line.

fixed_features.feature: One constant-base exponential times a constant; short polynomial exponent.
fixed_features.justification: e-728 and q-48565/q-107458/q-71881 use the same outer exponential chain rule. No quotient/product or trigonometric rule is needed.

fixed_features.feature: Easy asks for a symbolic derivative or the supplied-exponential coefficient; moderate/hard add only their observed stages.
fixed_features.justification: q-312462 specifies the coefficient field; q-48659 evaluates a slope; q-107463 builds a tangent line. These response demands cannot be interchanged merely to increase variety.

fixed_features.feature: Five options for radio fields, one mathematical input for a fragment.
fixed_features.justification: All supplied radio banks contain five expressions. Missing answer fields on some source questions are documented completions, not captured evidence.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Signs, small coefficients, degree and source-grounded two-term exponents may change while applying the same chain rule.
answer_roles.observed: Both leading signs across all implemented profiles; observed bases and bank roles recorded before and after delivery. Source-scaled linear family absent.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: c=1 or nonunit constant where source workload allows; e-728 establishes a nonunit multiplier with a linear exponent.
answer_roles.observed: c varies for scaled quadratic/cubic easy profiles, but all linear easy profiles force c=1. Controlled c-only change rejected.

answer_roles.observed: Positions and all three coefficient-bank roles vary; singleton has an authored 1/3 role prior, so modest guessing advantage is disclosed rather than credited as mathematical variety.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Familiar source-scale points of either sign; correct slope, ordinate and line must follow.
answer_roles.observed: Both point-only pairs passed independent mathematics, native grading and actual UI rendering.

coverage.case: Scaled linear derivative, including canonical e-728
coverage.result: FAILED: all nine easy template parameter paths reject the canonical c=3,n=1 backbone. Every implemented easy linear family fixes outside multiplier to 1. Changing only c=1 to c=3 is rejected by q-107461.

counterfactuals.change: Flip leading exponent coefficient while holding remaining parameters and seed fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Changed displayed exponential, inner derivative, complete target, explanation and learner key must remain mutually consistent.
counterfactuals.observed: Twelve accepted coefficient-flip pairs changed the independent response; all their keys and derivative solution lines matched the displayed functions, with actual radio choices and blank responses graded. The hard original sign flip was rejected by the evaluated exponent bound, so the hard dependency was tested separately using point-only changes.
counterfactuals.justification: e-728 multiplies the derivative of u into the exponential derivative; q-48565/q-107458/q-71881 demonstrate several inner-polynomial cases.

counterfactuals.change: Change only evaluation point in reciprocal-slope and linear tangent-equation templates.
counterfactuals.expected: Curve unchanged; evaluated derivative and tangent line must follow the new point.
counterfactuals.observed: Both point-only pairs changed their response as independently expected. All 20 native radio checks passed (4 accepted,16 rejected); before/after actual UI screenshots show the changed point and matching worked evaluation.
counterfactuals.justification: q-48659 evaluates the derivative at x=1/7; q-107463 additionally constructs the line through the curve point.

counterfactuals.change: Change exponent constant shift in a factor-only question; separately change choice/bank seed with all function parameters fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Fragment answer unchanged when the supplied exponential absorbs the new shift; derivative unchanged by rearranged/different distractors.
counterfactuals.observed: Both independent responses were preserved. Native before-response submissions remained accepted for the fragment pair, and each radio key/choice bank was independently checked and graded. Actual UI shows matching fragments, updated supplied exponent, and the same derivative under changed bank presentation.
counterfactuals.justification: q-312462 supplies the exponential outside field-1; constants differentiate to zero. Choice position has no mathematical role in q-107459.

counterfactuals.change: Change only outside multiplier from 1 to 3 in the easy linear derivative family.
counterfactuals.expected: The prompt should acquire the multiplier and derivative coefficient should triple, without adding a chain-rule stage.
counterfactuals.observed: FAILED: q-107461 rejects the after parameters with Preserve outside scale workload. No after prompt, explanation or learner-grader outcome can be rendered because the generator prevents the source-grounded variation. Canonical c=3,n=1 also fails through every easy template.
counterfactuals.justification: The primary canonical example e-728 explicitly differentiates 3*2^u and retains the factor 3. Thus c=1 is not an essential restriction of easy linear chain-rule practice.

shortcut_probes.strategy: Choose the smallest signed coefficient, without computing its magnitude from the exponent.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 6/9 versus 1/5 random selection. Reading the exponent sign legitimately identifies the derivative sign because base>1. This sign knowledge is mathematical, so this partial predictor is not classified as an incidental fixed label/layout defect.

stages_examined: publisher prepare_records validation/normalization and inventory/batch deduplication
conditional learner selection rule and fresh easy-band support
delivery.result: Captured basis 3948. Actual shared delivery keeps 106/107 easy,33/33 moderate,9/9 hard independently sampled records and5/5 runner records. One repeated easy record deduplicates; template/sign/bank-role coverage survives. Sampler had21 parameter rejections and0 bank rejections. Actual selection code is band-first then uniform within configured band; conditional 4096 seed reproduction visits all106 reviewed easy survivors. Native valid log equivalents remain unresolved after delivery. Scaled-linear family cannot appear before or after filtering.

limitations: Finite chosen seeds and explicit boundaries cannot prove absence of every shortcut. Small sign subgroups are descriptive; no universal significance claim.

No active learner policy, history or future entity IDs were supplied. Selection conclusions are conditional on fresh candidates and a positive easy-band weight; unconfigured selector chooses first ID.
Captured inventory may change after basis3948. No preparation file existed, so actual prepare_records was applied read-only with check_delivery.py.
Zero evaluated slopes and bases below1 are outside this conservative source-grounded sampler; no requirement that every mathematically possible case be generated.
Canonical e-728 has no captured answer field. The demonstrated omission concerns its function and chain-rule backbone, not an invented original response widget.
Source q-48631 lacks a solution/key/difficulty; inferred easy completion is mathematically checked and distinguished from observed evidence.
